text: This report recommends that the name "Walnut Hall Place" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Jarvis Street, extending northerly from Shuter Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Walnut Hall Place" for an existing public lane east of Jarvis Street, extending northerly from Shuter Street.
